CustomField.description: Tier-1 completeness flag for Hotline_Call. The website fills the caller-side; this checks the advocate-side fields (Outcome, Contact link, Outcome_Notes, Advocate). List-view-filterable to find calls awaiting follow-up.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Outcome__c))), NOT(ISNULL(Contact__c)), NOT(ISNULL(Advocate__c)), NOT(ISNULL(Call_End_DateTime__c)) ), "✓ Complete", "⚠ Needs review: " & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Outcome__c)), "Outcome · ", "") & IF(ISNULL(Contact__c), "Contact link · ", "") & IF(ISNULL(Advocate__c), "Advocate assigned · ", "") & IF(ISNULL(Call_End_DateTime__c), "Call end time · ", "") )
CustomField.label: Completeness Status
